changelog: DRIVE THE BATTLEFIELD WITH THE MOUSE. Hold the RIGHT button and drag to pan the table — it grabs the ground and carries it with the cursor rather than pushing a scrollbar, and it keeps working if you drag off the board and let go over the HUD. THE WHEEL NOW ZOOMS. It used to pan, because until right-drag existed scrolling was the only way to move around; now that there is another way to pan, the wheel does the thing everyone reaches for first, anchored on the tile under your cursor so zooming holds its place instead of jumping to the middle. Mac trackpads are unaffected: two-finger scroll still pans and pinch still zooms, because the two inputs are told apart rather than one being traded for the other. PLAY IT FROM THE KEYBOARD. The whole battle is now reachable without the mouse. Left and right — or A and D — walk along your hand, 1 to 9 jump straight to a card, down looks at the focused card and up plays it. Tab turns the danger overlays on and off as one thing. Q flips a gun between Aim and Move. F fires your Command Power, E ends the turn, T opens your army, R your deck and G your relics. Escape cancels what you are doing, or closes whatever is open. Plus and minus zoom, 0 returns to the whole board. Every one of them is listed under How to Play, so you do not have to go looking. FIXED: a coach tip could end up drawn behind the very panel it was describing after a long session of opening and closing menus.
